title: A finished chain build's write is replayed on a fresh trial site of its own, from the build's frozen inputs, with no model call
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A replay takes the build's own plan, copy, brand and pictures (stand-ins for a gone run), makes its own trial site with --keep-others, writes and checks it in that order and answers the chain's diagnostics; one replay runs at a time and frees the next start when it ends or fails; the bench removes only the earlier sites of the same label with --keep-others.

tests: a replay writes the build's own inputs to its own trial site, then checks it, and answers as the chain does
one replay at a time: a second start while one runs is refused, and starts again once it ends
a step whose run is gone gets the chain's own stand-in, and the replay says it was not the build's
a trial site that is not made ends the replay with its words, and nothing is written
a replay whose files cannot be laid out fails in words, and the next one can start
with keepOthers, only the earlier sites of the same label are removed; another line keeps its trial site
